name: todox
description: The log your next session resumes from: decisions, dead ends, handoffs and open tasks, shared across machines, agents and people over the todox MCP server. Reminds a session to read the log first and to write it up before finishing.

token.title: todox agent token
token.description: From the Account page on todox.dev (or your own instance). Starts with todox_. Stored in your Claude Code settings, never in this plugin.
